name: Audyssey calibration mic (bundled with AV receivers)
kind: omnidirectional electret capsule, 3.5 mm plug, needs plug-in power
connection: MacBook 3.5 mm headset jack (CTIA TRRS). A plain TS/TRS plug may short the mic contact; if macOS shows no external microphone, use a TRS-mic -> TRRS adapter or a USB-C audio interface with plug-in power.
placement: Ear height at the listening seat, capsule pointing at the ceiling (as for Audyssey/AccuEQ).
notes: APPROXIMATE, VERIFY: no per-unit calibration is published; the AVR applies a generic model correction internally.
Community comparisons (AV Nirvana) find it close to UMIK-1/Dayton capsules without cal files; assumed ~flat 20 Hz-10 kHz.
Above ~10 kHz the response is uncertain, so it is excluded from the EQ solve.
